def nanstd(x, axis=0, bias=False):
    """Compute the standard deviation over the given axis ignoring nans
    """
    x, axis = _chk_asarray(x,axis)
    x = x.copy()
    Norig = x.shape[axis]
    n = Norig - sum(isnan(x),axis)*1.0
    factor = n/Norig

    putmask(x,isnan(x),0)
    m1 = stats.mean(x,axis)
    m1c = m1/factor
    m2 = stats.mean((x-m1c)**2.0,axis)

    return m2c
